about: Sonaselection India is an integrated cotton and blended fabric manufacturer and processor based in Bhilwara, Rajasthan. It operates a single facility with 82.44 million meters per annum installed capacity and is shifting from job-work to selling its own manufactured fabric. Revenue from operations was Rs 516.95 crore in FY26.

objects.purpose: Capex for plant and machinery at existing Bhilwara facility (efficiency, no capacity increase)
General corporate purposes (capped at 25% of gross proceeds)

promoters.background: Nuwal family and Deepank Bhandari with textile experience; promoters sold 5.75% (Bhandari) and 2.80% (Nuwal) after DRHP filing; personal guarantees given for company loans.

concentration.note: Top 10 customers 29.44% of FY26 revenue (37.98% FY25, 48.15% FY24); top customer 4.65%. Top 10 suppliers 58.87% of purchases; Rajasthan 37.31% of revenue and 96% of procurement.

litigation_note: Few material cases: one criminal FIR (2015, Bhopal) against promoters and a senior manager, settled by a promoter-group entity for Rs 1.08 million but formal closure pending; one MSME creditor claim of Rs 2.45 million; one tax proceeding.
strengths: Revenue grew from Rs 121 crore in FY24 to Rs 517 crore in FY26 (about 107% CAGR) while PAT rose to Rs 34 crore.
Integrated model combining in-house fabric manufacturing and job-work processing at one facility with 82.44 MMPA capacity.
Return on net worth of 39.05% and ROCE of 19.69% in FY26.
Capacity utilisation of 82.71% in FY26, up from 78.24% in FY25 after the July 2024 expansion.
Located in Bhilwara, an established textile cluster, with machinery from reputed global suppliers.
Customer concentration is falling: top 10 customers were 29.44% of revenue in FY26 versus 48.15% in FY24.
Debt-equity ratio has improved from 3.72 in FY24 to 2.48 in FY26 as net worth grew.
Credit rating of BBB/Stable from Crisil on long-term borrowings.

risks.title: Very high debt
risks.detail: Debt-equity ratio was 2.48 in FY26 (3.72 in FY24); bank loans were Rs 263.84 crore at July 2026 and Rs 19.77 crore unsecured loans are repayable on demand. Only Rs 80 crore of IPO money goes to debt repayment.

risks.title: Negative operating cash flow
risks.detail: Operating cash flow was negative Rs 10.99 crore in FY26 and Rs 14.18 crore in FY25 despite profits, as inventory and receivables grew; inventory days rose to 150.

risks.title: Heavy related-party dealings
risks.detail: FY26 purchases and job processing of Rs 24.91 crore (4.82% of revenue) from group company Sona Styles, plus loans and interest payments with promoters and their entities.

risks.title: Single facility and Rajasthan concentration
risks.detail: All production is at one Bhilwara plant; Rajasthan gave 37.31% of FY26 revenue and 96.01% of purchases.

risks.title: Business model transition
risks.detail: Job-work fell from 88.72% of revenue in FY24 to 17.30% in FY26 as manufacturing rose to 81.50%, raising working-capital, raw-material and margin risks; EBITDA margin fell from 23.55% to 16.40%.

risks.title: Customer and supplier concentration
risks.detail: Top 10 customers are 29.44% of revenue with no long-term contracts; top 10 suppliers are 58.87% of purchases (80.74% in FY25) with no supply contracts.

risks.title: Promoter issues and share sales
risks.detail: Promoters face a pending 2015 criminal FIR; Deepank Bhandari was earlier disqualified as director; promoters sold 5.75% and 2.80% of their holdings after DRHP filing; personal guarantees back company loans.

risks.title: Regulatory non-compliances and unappraised objects
risks.detail: Delayed Companies Act filings of 51 and 194 days under RoC adjudication; capex plan of Rs 50.61 crore has no orders placed and has not been appraised by any bank, and adds no capacity.

notes: FY26 consolidated (subsidiary since July 2025); FY25 and FY24 are standalone per the business section. Figures converted from Rs million. Price band, issue size, P/E and post-issue shares are blank in the RHP. Current ratio computed from total current assets and liabilities as it is not reported; ROE not reported (RoNW used in ronw). Peer revenue and column mapping in the garbled peer table were inferred (revenue, RoNW and P/E cross-checked against the KPI table). Net worth equals share capital plus other equity; reserves equals other equity. Peer CMP not given. Anchor reservation not stated as fixed percentage (up to 60% of QIB portion).
